rationale.risk-routing: Composite scores and thresholds decide whether actions are blocked, sanitized, or escalated.
rationale.ai-review: Probabilistic safety classifiers independently judge proposed agent actions.
rationale.rules-based-checks: OPA, schemas, regex, and FSM provide deterministic grounded checks.
rationale.formal-methods: Specifies FSM invariants and model-checkable safety and liveness properties.
rationale.remediation-gating: Policies autonomously sanitize risky payloads before execution without per-fix approval.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Escalated actions suspend execution until an authorized human decides.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Policies detect and constrain tool actions departing from intended scope.
rationale.org-governance: Enterprise policy-as-code, role scoping, and audit infrastructure operationalize governance.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Policies and evidence trails operationalize EU, ISO, and NIST requirements.
rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Signed policy bundles, attestations, SBOM checks, and reviewer-evasion defenses.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Append-only records preserve actions, risk vectors, policy versions, and outcomes.
rationale.framework: Reusable cloud-native architecture integrates scoring, policies, classifiers, enforcement, and audit.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and benchmarked the policy-engine microservice across three workloads.
rationale.general-ai: The governed objects are agent actions broadly, not AI-generated code.
rationale.agentic: The system governs autonomous multi-step agents at action and tool-call gates.
rationale.metrics: Defines and calibrates security, compliance, and privacy risk scores.
